big: Silver had its strongest annual performance since 1979 in 2025 and hit new highs in early 2026. The market is in deficit for a sixth straight year. Why does supply not simply rise when the price rises?

lines: Only about 28% of silver comes from primary silver mines. Most is a by-product of copper, lead, zinc and gold. So miners of those metals decide the supply, and supply barely responds to a higher silver price. The deficit is about 46 Moz in 2026 per the World Silver Survey.
